entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Happy is the worshipper of the Lord, who is walking in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: You will have the fruit of the work of your hands: happy will you be, and all will be well for you.

entries.title: Psalms 128:3
segments: Your wife will be like a fertile vine in the inmost parts of your house: your children will be like olive plants round your table.

entries.title: Psalms 128:4
segments: See! this is the blessing of the worshipper of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: May the Lord send you blessing out of Zion: may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel.
